title: Act three on the ground (smash, grab, execution)
steps: Thrown clear of the RV crashed at the pole in T2, lying on the road in heavy fog. F3 starts the timeline: the eyes open on your own arms on the road; look up at the giant tearing at the roof, and when it turns to you, crawl back (S) while watching it. As it reaches for you the take cuts to a still third-person camera, and the game's execution view takes over at the speaker. Cut on the death marker in take.json.
